method: TEXT/POLICY REVIEW ONLY - no image opened, no pixel claim

records.reason: A letter/sound count is not a language category, the file's own note says the brackets and the sound spelling on this line are the teacher's green pen, and uncertain[] shows the count may be a misread numeral. Pixels must settle both ownership and value.

Verbatim 'ветерёк' is not a Russian word; the standard diminutive is 'ветерок'. The list keeps ё correctly in денёк and позёмка, so this is the pupil's ё-for-о, not the transcriber's convention. Correction needs no dictated source.

uncertain[] says the ending is written over by the teacher's green mark and 'reads Восковый rather than Восковой'. The pupil's letter is not established by the visible text; the preserved ink decides.

'охрипеть' exists as a colloquial verb, so 'Охрипели' is not demonstrably a non-word, and the exercise's key word is nowhere in the notebook: the paired list (вытопили / сохранят / проверили) gives no contrast to force 'охрипли'. Correction not unique from this source.

The file contradicts itself about the ink: page_lines reads 'солённый' while edges_checked_and_kept records 'Соль-соляная, солёный' for the same bottom line, and the teacher's red pen marks root and suffix on it. Number of н and the drill's intended form need the pixels.

Already adjudicated by eye: sample3_adjudication.json key p08-l16|Ледянец, verdict 'error' - '«Леденец» - the pupil wrote я for е in a Лёд/леденец derivation exercise'. uncertain[] confirms the form is the pupil's own.

Riddle line. Whether the refrain should read 'на яру' (or 'на горе') is a question for the riddle's dictated text, which is not in the notebook; the transcript is internally consistent with what it shows.

Verbatim 'точта' is a non-word inside a dictionary word list (газета, ракета, растение, ребята, сочинение, … иллюстрация), and the correction 'почта' is the word uncertain[] names. Confidence low because the same flag says the first letter could be a misread.

A verse transcription: the poem's own short lines may replace commas between homogeneous verbs, and the teacher's green pen already wrote 'пла-чет'. Missing commas cannot be established without the source; excluded as a note-taking convention until then.
Canonical note and uncertain[]: the last word is blue under a green underline at the margin and not legible. Nothing about that word can be adjudicated from text.

uncertain[]: 'possibly an abbreviation; read letter by letter', with a green circled mark beside it; the candidate pass also classes it a clipped fragment. It is not safe to judge as prose - the ink decides whether it is a word at all.

The pupil's own rule line two rows above says 'Правописание наречий через дефис 1. По + ому(ему)', and this is its example. The hyphen is required inside the word; the pupil writes hyphens elsewhere on the page (чуть-чуть, l20), so the verbatim gap is his. Not the deferred digit-word case.
Second example on the same rule-1 row ('По + ому(ему)') written without the required hyphen; the correction is fixed by the rule the pupil is copying.
Example under row 2 'По + и' on the same line, written without the required hyphen.
Carry 'по дру-' + 'жески' and this token are the row-2 'По + и' examples; 'по немецки' lacks the required hyphen. The marked carry is a normal wrap and is judged once with its half.
Row 3 on the same line reads 'В(во) + ых(их) от числительных'; this numeral adverb must be hyphenated.
Same row-3 rule on the same line ('В(во) + ых(их) от числительных'); the hyphen is required.
Row 4 on the same line reads 'Кое:', i.e. the кое- prefix is hyphenated in the pupil's own rule; 'кое где' is written bare.
Second row-4 example, written bare under the pupil's own '4. Кое:' rule on the same line.

The phrase is repeated in the verbatim text, but a repeated item in note-taking is exactly the case left open by the founder (canonical p04-M2 awaits a ruling on duplicated definitions), and whether the repetition is the pupil's ink or a transcription slip needs the pixels.

Row 5 heads the hyphenated particles and the same pupil writes them bare again in the parallel rule at p12-l36 ('частицы пишутся через дефис с местоимен.: то, либо, нибудь, кое,'). Precedent: canonical p02-l27 'что либо' -> 'что-либо', counts_as_error true. Confidence low because the pupils' capital 'То' shows the row is reading as a bare word list.
'до сих пор' may be missing here or may sit at the end of the previous line; the line above ends 'вчера,' in the verbatim text, so the ink decides.

Example row beside the brace table 'В На За -> о'. The capitals track the brace's own prefix labels, which is a table/note-taking convention; no capitalisation error is established without looking at the table's ink.
Same question as P10-U02 against the second brace 'Из До С -> а'; all three capitals are exactly the brace's own labels, so the ink must decide.

This cell of the composition table lists compound prepositions (до, к, из, из-за, из-под … в связи с); 'в течении' is the noun form, the derivative preposition is 'в течение'. Correction fixed by standard orthography, no dictated source needed.
The pupil's own example 'идти навстречу друзьями': 'навстречу' governs the dative, so 'друзьям'. Established by grammar inside the line.

Non-word inside the pupil's own list '3. Всегда пишутся слитно: вреде, вместо, ввиду, насчет, напо-добии, навстречу'. uncertain[] mentions 'в виде' as an alternative, but the always-separate list two lines below (l29) already contains 'в виде', so the solid preposition meant here is 'вроде' - a single-letter reading, kept verbatim.
Marked carry 'напо-' + 'добии' joins to 'наподобии' (uncertain[]: the pupil's own ending); the always-solid preposition is 'наподобие'. One record for the joined word, not the halves.

Heading item '1. Последовательно' against the pupil's own 'Паралельное подчинение' and 'Однородное подчинение' two lines below. The adverb-for-adjective claim competes with a truncated line-end reading of the same word, so the pixels decide; headings are not to be judged on shape alone.
Verbatim non-word 'Паралельное' (one л for two) in a heading the pupil wrote himself with the following noun; the same word was adjudicated an error at p24-l04 (sample3_adjudication.json).
uncertain[] records this line as the pupil's own agreement error ('мама наблюдал'); the feminine subject requires 'наблюдала'. No teacher source needed.

uncertain[] calls the whole line the pupil's own wording, and the transcribed phrase 'Частицы служебные часть речь который придают' is one composite garbled term: the joint correction could be 'служебные части речи, которые'. Neither component has a unique repair from text, and the composite stays one record.

Same composite phrase as P12-E04. With the plural verb 'придают' on the same line the relative pronoun could as well be 'которые', so the proposed 'которая' is not the unique correction; this component must not be split into a second record.
Mid-line token (no line break, so not a wrap) hyphenating a compound written solid: формообразующий. The extra hyphen is the pupil's per the verbatim text.
'перед тем' + instrumental: 'перед тем словом или словосочетанием'. The pupil's 'словам' disagrees with 'тем' on the same line; established by grammar.

'вносить … в + accusative' is the normal government (внести оттенки значения в предложение). As transcribed the phrase is grammatical Russian, so no specific pupil error and no unique correction is established - the claim is awkwardness, not a defect.

Compressed classification heading in the pupil's own note ('1. По значению', '2. Отрицательные', '3. По Модальный.'). Several readings of the shorthand are open and the dictated heading is unavailable, so no single correction is established.

'нету' is an attested colloquial form, not a letter-level deviation from a key; it is a register choice inside the pupil's own note-taking, so no error is established without a founder ruling on register.
Already adjudicated by eye: sample3_adjudication.json key p13-l16|подставает, verdict 'error' - 'not a Russian word; the sentence wants «передает»'. uncertain[] records the form as the pupil's own.
uncertain[] records the set phrase 'слава богу' written as 'слова богу'; 'слова' cannot stand in the exclamation, and the correction is the single fixed phrase.
'являться' governs the instrumental: 'может являться членом предложения'. The pupil wrote 'членам'; established by grammar, no source needed.
'в некоторых' + prepositional plural: 'в некоторых случаях'. Established by grammar inside the line.
uncertain[] records the pupil's own spelling; 'подрыжание' is a non-word and the term in this definition of звукоподражание is 'подражание'.

uncertain[] records 'по' where 'но' is meant; the adversative conjunction is required between the two participial phrases of the Паронимы definition. The single п/н slip makes a valid word, but the correction is fixed by the sentence.
uncertain[]: the pupil's own form in a line cut on the left. шапкой/сапкой cannot be separated from the visible text - needs the source or the pixels.
The term pair is производные/непроизводные, but 'не производные' is also a legitimate negated phrase, so a one-word correction is not established from text; the ink decides whether the gap is real.
uncertain[] calls this the pupil's own wording for 'словосочетания'. Three tokens with an unexpected 'образа' do not establish one specific correction or one specific defect class from text.
'раздел' + genitive; the pupil's own parallel line p14-l02 two rows above reads 'раздел лингвистики изучающий', so the correction is established by his own context, not by a missing key.

The verbatim line carries a Latin-letter artifact inside the word ('postановку') and a double space after 'правильное', so this line's tokenisation is not trustworthy as ink; the pixels must settle it.

The pupil's neighbouring definition lines drop the noun after 'правильное' (l04-l05 'раздел лингвистика изуч. правильное' + 'слов.'), so the mismatch here may be note compression ('правильное [произношение] … постановку ударения') rather than an agreement error. Not established from text.

The particle -либо takes a hyphen; precedent canonical p02-l27 'что либо' -> 'что-либо' (counts_as_error true, founder). Only the hyphen is claimed: the transcript shows no ё, and no ё is written into the expected form. Confidence low because this is a two-word particle inside running prose; the proposal's 'о чём-либо' adds a diacritic the transcript does not show.
uncertain[]: the pupil's own wording for 'односоставное'. Whether a paraphrase of the term counts as an error needs the dictated key; not settled by the visible text.
The pupil's own form for 'двусоставное', with the pupil's own spacing around the hyphen; same open question as P14-U01.
Plural subject 'Вспомогательные' requires 'глаголы'; the pupil wrote the singular 'глагола'. Established by grammar inside the line.

The anomalous 'э' sits in an unverified joined carry ('свяэ-' + 'ками'), and the identical anomaly recurs at p16-l26 - which points to a systematic reading artifact of cursive з rather than a pupil letter. The joined candidate is not pixel-verified; the ink decides.

The term is 'между подлежащим и сказуемым', which the pupil himself writes correctly on the next line (p15-l28); 'подлежащими' cannot pair with singular 'сказуемым'. Correction established by his own parallel line.
Frozen phrase 'в роли связки' (prepositional); the pupil wrote the accusative 'в роль'. Established by grammar.
'в лучах заката' (genitive); 'закатах' doubles the plural of the governed noun and cannot stand. Established by grammar inside the line.
Neuter antecedent 'определение' requires 'которое'; the pupil's masculine 'который' cannot agree with it. Established by grammar; the comma is incidental to the record.
The case after 'в значении' is not settled by the visible text (both 'продолжение' and 'продолжения' have support); needs the source or the pixels.
uncertain[]: reads 'постер' inside a garbled quotation; the intended word is not resolvable from text.
uncertain[] records the pupil's own spelling; 'недлимым' is a non-word and the term in this definition is 'неделимым … сочетанием слов'. Mid-line token, no carry.

uncertain[]: reads 'Обычать' where 'Обычай' is meant, in sentence-opening position of a garbled quotation. The word cannot stand as written; confidence low because the whole quotation is uncertain and the ink reading is flagged.

uncertain[] calls it the pupil's own ending. 'выдумам' can be repaired as 'выдумки' (agreeing with 'мои') or as 'выдумкам', and the quotation is garbled: the dictated source is required, so the correction is not unique.
'по' + dative: 'по значению понятно из контекста'; the pupil wrote the nominative. Established by grammar inside the line.
Same anomalous 'э' as P15-E02, again inside an unverified joined carry ('свяэ-' + 'ки'); most likely the same reading artifact of cursive з. The joined candidate is not pixel-verified.

Number agreement would need 'односоставные простые предложения', but this very token was adjudicated by eye as an artefact on the non-word screen (sample3, p16-l36|односоставное: 'real Russian word'). The two questions must be settled at the pixels by Astra; if counted it is one composite with 'простые', not a new defect to assert now.

The clause lacks its opening preposition and case ('В неполных предложениях … может стоять тире'), but it may equally be a compressed note start; the exact repair needs the ink or the dictated sentence.

notes: Review basis: verbatim canonical text (canonical/page-07..16.json), LABELLING-POLICY.md (founder, 2026-09-12), TRANSCRIPTION-STATE.md, the packet policy.json, and the candidate/adjudication evidence (labels_astra_candidates.json, labels_provisional.json, sample3_adjudication.json). No image was opened and no canonical file was touched; nothing here is pixel-confirmed.

ACCEPT means the verbatim canonical text plus its local context fixes both the pupil error and the correction without the dictated source. UNDECIDED means a count is possible but the reading, the ink ownership or the unique correction is not available from text. REJECT means no error is established (policy-excluded or merely awkward).

Evidence reused rather than re-derived: sample3_adjudication.json (Astra by eye) supplies the accepted verdicts for p08-l16|Ледянец and p13-l16|подставает; canonical p02-l27 ('что либо' -> 'что-либо', counts_as_error true) is the precedent for the particle hyphens; canonical p04-M2 shows a duplicated definition in note-taking left open by the founder, which is why P10-E09 is deferred.

Deferred flags follow LABELLING-POLICY section 1: agreement, case and sentence-level claims are deferred true; letter-level (spelling) defects and the hyphenation defects here (none of them the digit-word case the policy names) are deferred false.

Not proposed but visible in the same lines, recorded for completeness, not added as records: 'по дру-' + 'жески' (p10-l28, the third row-2 example) and the bare particles 'то, либо, нибудь, кое,' (p12-l36) carry the same defect the accepted P10-E03/P10-E04 and P10-E10 record.

The vision route is unused (proposal method_note and vision_bakeoff): subagent vision is not usable as a second annotator here, so this review is text/policy only and can neither confirm nor refute anything that depends on the pixels.
confirmation_limits: This review cannot confirm or refute any pixel-dependent claim (scores are text-only); UNDECIDED records are deferred to Astra's by-eye adjudication, not rejected.
